deploy-bot: RC open: rc-quietlaunch-0328 head=de4f9a repo=platform/serve artifacts=[serve:2026.03.28.qlaunch] promo-window=2026-03-28T22:00Z..22:40Z
olivia: created RC to address rare kv eviction during long sessions. tagging @mira QA, @ash oncall, @leo PM. considering a quiet-launch (no wide customer notice) with artifact pin fallback.
sam: note: this build includes a small kernel timing tweak. not a full micro-bump but could affect tail latency. recommend staged canary + pin plan.
mira: smoke on staging now. will post results in 6m.
ash (deploy-bot): smoke queued id=smoke-8891
carol: heads-up from infra: we can cherry-pick just the kv eviction patch into the stable artifact and avoid the kernel tweak. that reduces blast radius.
olivia: nice — do we have a cherry-pick artifact ready? command to build would be `rb cherry-pick de4f9a --target=serve:2026.03.25.stable --name=serve:2026.03.28.cherry`
sam: that seems safest. timeline tradeoff +20m for cherry-pick build. are we ok slipping the promo window?
leo: product prefers quieter rollout but faster fix. if cherry-pick delays past window, prefer staged canary with TTL extension.
mira: smoke passed on staging; no repro.
ash: ops recommendation: build cherry-pick in parallel; if ready before 22:10Z, use it as pin target for promo; otherwise use head with canary TTL-extension. starting staged plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% hold checks. alerts: 5xx >50% or p95 >1.5x baseline.
carol: cherry-pick build started: ci/job/4321 -> serve:2026.03.28.cherry
ash: canary start (5%) scheduled at 22:00Z with env KV_TTL_MULTIPLIER=3 for canary instances.
mira: QA will run targeted kv_warm acceptance against canary.
carol: cherry-pick artifact ready at 22:03Z: serve:2026.03.28.cherry (includes only kv eviction patch).
olivia: decision: pin to cherry artifact for promo to eliminate kernel tweak risk. execute pin: `rb pin serve --artifact=serve:2026.03.28.cherry`
sam: issuing pin now and starting canary 5%.
ash: canary started: tag=quietlaunch-canary-01 traffic=5%
mira: QA acceptance passed on canary (kv_warm). no 500s observed in 20m.
ash: promoting to 25% per plan.
leo: hold 15m then decide for full promo. :eyes:
ash: 25% hold complete. metrics: p95 +3%, 5xx stable. proceeding to 100% now. rollout hooks: `rb promote rc-quietlaunch-0328 --strategy=staged`
ash: promotion complete: rc-quietlaunch-0328 -> prod; serving artifact serve:2026.03.28.cherry
olivia: posting internal status note (no public status page): "Mitigated intermittent session 500s via kv-cache eviction fix. Quiet launch; staged rollout complete. Monitoring ongoing."
mira: post-promo QA sweep: everything green.
ash: rollback snippet if needed:
```
rb rollback rc-quietlaunch-0328 --to=serve:2026.03.25.stable
notify --channel=incidents --msg="rollback executed: rc-quietlaunch-0328 -> serve:2026.03.25.stable"
```
carol: follow-up: add cherry-pick test to premerge checklist to reduce future urgency.
leo: thanks team. closing RC unless anyone objects.
mira: closing QA. no objections.
deploy-bot: RC archived. changelog: https://internal.changelog/rc-quietlaunch-0328
